title: Programs
summary: AAEF has joined to support the Royal Albert Hall’s Young Peoples Programs
body:
AAEF has joined to support the Royal Albert Hall’s Young Peoples Programs.

These programs include:

Future Makers finding Tomorrow’s Music Talent

Future Makers is an exciting new opportunity for young London-based musicians. Taking place each year commencing on 9 November 2022, this main stage event at the Royal Albert Hall will feature young creatives from across the capital performing their original works to a stellar industry panel, invited guests and an audience of young people.

Artist Workshops and Master Classes

The aim of the workshops and Master Classes , with some of the biggest artists performing at the Hall, is to provide an inspirational opportunity for a range of young people by giving them access to high profile musicians representing all genres; the artist’s world-class knowledge and musicianship offer invaluable learning. Each session is tailored according to what the artist is passionate about and comfortable leading.

Young Producers Scheme

This program offers the opportunity for budding young producers to be provided with a budget to organise and create an evening of events at the Royal Albert Hall . They will be given the support and guidance during regular workshops with Hall staff to gain invaluable experience in putting on events , from programming and marketing to event management .The event will be held in the Hall’s Elgar Room , a world class and incredibly flexible performance space.
